titles.title: Daggerfall
titles.engine: Bethesda XnGine, DOS: FALL.EXE ('TES: Daggerfall v1.07.', GOG build, CauseWay LE), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74-2.1 (DOSBOX\DOSBox.exe md5 2318a446..., the binary's version strings say 0.74-2.1; the launcher's comment saying 0.74-3 is stale)
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed statically and now measured. Play Daggerfall.bat does: call FLEETRES.BAT, then FLEETRES.EXE -ini dosbox_daggerfall.conf sdl fullresolution %FR_DOSFULLRES%, then start "Daggerfall" DOSBox.exe -conf ..\dosbox_daggerfall.conf -conf ..\dosbox_daggerfall_fleet.conf -noconsole. The second conf is [autoexec] only. GAMERES rule: gameres.h:797. Deployed conf on all four LCD boxes: fullresolution=desktop, output=overlay, aspect=true. MEASURED on .240 (XP, Radeon X800) on 2026-09-29 at 01:22: DISPLAYCFG stayed 1920x1080x32 with no mode switch, and at the Load/Start/Exit menu the content box was 1440x1080 at x=240..1680. That is a correct 4:3 pillarbox.
titles.menu_source: There is no video-mode option anywhere. Z.CFG keywords, read out of FALL.EXE's own table: path, pathcd, controls, fadecolor, mapfile, faction, startMap, artifact, facloop, custom, item, gender, ps2fix, user, region, debug, blockStr, helmet, maps, marker, seed, stereo, objmemsize, TextureMemory, MagicRepair, cheatMode. None is a video key. SETUP.EXE/SETUP.INI is the HMI Sound Operating System setup only. Caveat the survey missed: FALL.EXE does contain a VBE probe and set-mode routine near file offset 0x1A7280 (INT 10h 4F00 checks the 'VESA' signature and version >= 1.02, then 4F01 and 4F02). No config key or menu reaches it, so it is not a player-selectable resolution. The game renders 320x200.
titles.evidence: Staged tree /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library/Daggerfall (Play Daggerfall.bat, dosbox_daggerfall.conf lines 28/30/63, dosbox_daggerfall_fleet.conf, Z.CFG, SETUP.INI). Keyword table from strings of FALL.EXE. Hardware screenshot: .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/hw/240_daggerfall_60s.png (content bbox 240..1680 x 0..1080). GAMERES re-read of all four LCD boxes: .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/boxes/*-GAMERES-review.txt. Prior survey files: survey-dosbox-descent-carma/boxes/*_Daggerfall__dosbox_daggerfall.conf.
titles.fix: None needed. The DOSBox answer (desktop plus aspect=true giving a 1440x1080 pillarbox) is present and now verified on an LCD box. Daggerfall Unity is the only true 1080p renderer. It is a different engine, not on the share (searched case-insensitively), and needs Windows 7 or later, so at most .195 could run it; the XP boxes cannot.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: FLEETRES.BAT/EXE, the launcher line generated by scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (entry 'Daggerfall'), and the GAMERES rule at agent/shared/gameres.h:797.
titles.fix_risk: None (no change). Operational hazard found: while Daggerfall's DOSBox runs (GOG conf priority=higher, cycles=fixed 50000), agent EXEC on .240 is CPU-starved. Measured: EXEC taskkill, tasklist and dir all hit the 60 s timeout, the client's replies desynced, and taskkill.exe was left orphaned (killed afterwards). The agent-internal PROCKILL <pid> worked at once. Any automated check or cleanup for this title must use PROCKILL, not EXEC taskkill.
titles.hw_check: Already done on .240. To repeat on another LCD box: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Daggerfall" "Play Daggerfall.bat". Wait about 60 s for the Load/Start/Exit scroll. DISPLAYCFG get must still read 1920x1080, and SCREENSHOT 0 should have its non-black bbox at x=240..1680 over the full height. Stop the game with WINLIST (read the DOSBox pid) and PROCKILL <pid>, not EXEC taskkill, then confirm the desktop is still 1920x1080. There is no resolution menu to navigate.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed, and upgraded from 'never seen on an LCD' to measured on .240. Corrections: (1) FALL.EXE is not VBE-free; see menu_source. (2) The compat DB still says Daggerfall is 'absent' on .123 and .246/.195. That is stale: DIRLIST shows C:\Games\Daggerfall (59 entries) on .123, .145, .195 and .240. (3) The EXEC starvation hazard above. (4) .240's EDID was reported missing after its ~23:40 reboot. I could not confirm that; its logs are rotated. It reads EDID/LCD 1920x1080 now, at 00:13 and again at 00:39. If a launch happens during an EDID dropout, FR_DOSFULLRES becomes 'original' and DOSBox switches the whole desktop to the DOS mode, on .240 only. Side effects of my run on .240, all normal for any launch: the launcher's FLEETRES -ini rewrote dosbox_daggerfall.conf (11,451 -> 11,453 B), and the game wrote cloud_saves\ARENA2\RUMOR.DAT and cloud_saves\PHQGHUME into the save overlay.

titles.title: Carmageddon1
titles.engine: BRender, DOS/4GW MAINPROG.EXE (GOG), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74 (md5 33294e0a...). The tree also carries the DOS 3Dfx Glide build 3DFXCARM\3DFX\CARMAV.EXE and the Glide 2.4.2 DOS driver installer GLIDE\GRTVGR.EXE. The survey did not mention either.
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed statically. All four launchers (Play, Host LAN, Join LAN, Sound Setup) contain the exact line FLEETRES.EXE -ini dosboxCarma.conf sdl fullresolution %FR_DOSFULLRES% and pass dosboxCarma.conf first. The _single, _lan and _settings confs and _ipxhost.conf hold [IPX]/[autoexec] only. GAMERES rule: gameres.h:793. dosboxCarma_single.conf runs MAINPROG.EXE -runme -hires (640x480x8 VESA). The deployed conf on the four LCD boxes reads desktop/overlay/aspect=true. The 08-31 .240 capture shows content at x=240..1680 (1440 wide). Not re-run tonight.
titles.menu_source: No in-game resolution option. The mode comes only from a command-line switch. MAINPROG.EXE's switch list is -deckchairs -hires -lomem -nocutscenes -runme -simple -sound -spamfritter -yon, and its only SVGA mode string is 'VESA,W:640,H:480,B:8'. Data sets exist for 320x200 and 640x480 only. The unwired 3Dfx build has the same ceiling: CARMAV.EXE's strings include '-hires' / '%s: force 640x480', -novoodoo, -vgraphics and -vrush.
titles.evidence: Staged tree /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library/Carmageddon1: four .bat files (grep: one FLEETRES -ini line each), dosboxCarma.conf lines 20/22/52 (original/overlay/aspect=true, rewritten per box), dosboxCarma_single.conf, 3DFXCARM\README.TXT ('DOS only exe... requires Glide 2.4.2'), README-FLEET.txt section 'THE 3DFX BUILD - NOT WIRED UP'. Prior screenshot: survey-dosbox-descent-carma/prior-0831/240_Carmageddon1_Play_Carmageddon.png (bbox 240..1680).
titles.fix: None needed for the shipped software build. 640x480 (-hires) is already used, and the desktop+aspect pillarbox is the correct 1080p presentation. The survey's claim that only a different engine could do better missed an in-tree option. CARMAV.EXE (the 3Dfx build) could render its 3D above 640x480 if run in a Glide-capable DOSBox with Glide passthrough to nGlide set to By desktop / 4:3, the way Carmageddon 2 was verified tonight. The nGlide 1.02 readme lists 'Carmageddon (DOSBox + Gulikoza's patch) 3dfx.exe' fixes. It remains optional and large, and it is not needed to meet 'the settings allow 1080p'.
titles.fix_source: The current path is already in the tree (stage-fleetres.py 'Carmageddon1' entry, gameres.h:793). The optional 3Dfx path would need a Glide-capable DOSBox (DOSBox-X, or an ECE/daum build) downloaded from outside. None is on the share (case-insensitive search: only GOG DOSBox 0.74, 0.74-2.1 and the 0.74-3 installer/dmg exist). CARMAV.EXE and nGlide 1.02 (in the Carmageddon2 tree) are already on the share.
titles.fix_risk: None for the no-change answer. The optional 3Dfx route means a new emulator on every box, DOSBox-X's XP support to verify, and a CPU cost on the slow boxes. LAN compatibility between CARMAV.EXE and MAINPROG.EXE is unknown, so the two-box IPX proof would have to be redone.
titles.hw_check: On .145 (never measured): EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Carmageddon1" "Play Carmageddon.bat". Wait out the roughly 2-minute intro FMV, or try UIKEY ESCAPE. DISPLAYCFG get must stay 1920x1080, and SCREENSHOT 0 content should sit inside x=240..1680. Stop with PROCKILL on the DOSBox pid (or taskkill /f /im "DOSBox.exe") and confirm the desktop mode. Treat front-end input as unverified: the survey says the menu is keyboard-navigable, but the compat DB row for this title says 'the front end ignores click *and* key'. Neither was tested tonight.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed, apart from the missed in-tree 3Dfx build (see fix). Also: README-FLEET.txt still describes Play Carmageddon.bat as opening a '1) Carmageddon 2) hi-res' menu, but dosboxCarma_single.conf now goes straight to -hires. That doc is stale; it is not a resolution defect. The .240 EDID-intermittency caveat from Daggerfall applies to every DOSBox title on that box.

titles.title: Carmageddon2
titles.engine: BRender Win32, CARMA2_HW.EXE v1.02a, Glide renderer (install.reg Driver=2, box-246 A/B: Driver=3 Direct3D crashes) through the game-local nGlide 1.02 (glide2x/glide3x/glide.dll, glide2x.dll md5 e4867e04, which wraps Glide to Direct3D 9)
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed and measured. Play Carmageddon 2.bat calls FLEETRES.BAT only for FR_GLIDE (the glide_swap block) and writes no resolution. gameres.h has no rule for this title. HKCU\Software\Zeus Software is absent on all four LCD boxes (REGREAD re-checked tonight; the same REGREAD with a spaced path works on HKCU Control Panel\Desktop), so nGlide runs 'By app'. MEASURED on .123 (XP, HD 3850): with the staged launcher, DISPLAYCFG went to 640x480x32, the Carma2MainWndClass window was 0,0-640x480, and the front end was captured as a 640x480 frame. The monitor's scaler then stretches that to the panel.
titles.menu_source: No in-game resolution setting. Graphics data exist only for 320x200 and 640x480 (data\32X20X8, data\64x48x8; '640x480 init string', 'Screen width/height doesn't match graf data'). The complete switch list is -SCALEMOUSE -AFE -ALIEN -BLOOD -ZOMBIE -D3D -NOCUTSCENES -NOCUTSCENE; the survey omitted -D3D. The only resolution chooser is the external nglide_config.exe. Its table, independently confirmed from glide2x.dll's own code, is index 0 By app, 1 By desktop, 2 640x480, 3 800x600, 5 1024x768, 6 1152x864, 10 1280x960, 11 1280x1024, 19 1600x1200, 21 1920x1080, clamped below 29. Aspect is 0 Fit to screen or 1 4:3.
titles.evidence: glide2x.dll disassembly (capstone): RegOpenKeyExA(0x80000001 HKCU, 'Software\Zeus Software\nGlide') at VA 0x100025dc. 'Resolution', 'Aspect', 'Refresh', 'Vsync', 'Gamma' and 'Splash' are each read with an untyped RegQueryValueExA into a 255-byte buffer, then sscanf('%d'); Resolution is clamped to < 0x1d. The width/height table is built on the stack, with index 21 = 0x780 x 0x438. DllMain PROCESS_ATTACH stores GetSystemMetrics(0/1), the live desktop size, at VA 0x10001661. Hardware (.123), under .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/hw/: baseline 123_carma2_baseline_25s.png (640x480); with the values 123_carma2_nglide_bydesktop_15s.png and 123_carma2_nglide_bydesktop_27s.png (FMV inside x=240..1680) and 123_carma2_after_esc3.png (front end at x=240..1680, full height, DISPLAYCFG 1920x1080x32 throughout). Agent log hw/logs/123-agent.log.1.
titles.fix: VERIFIED on .123: HKCU\Software\Zeus Software\nGlide with Resolution="1" and Aspect="1", both REG_SZ. DISPLAYCFG stayed 1920x1080 and every frame (FMV and front end) was nGlide-rendered as a correct 4:3 1440x1080 pillarbox at x=240..1680. Implement it in the launcher, before start "" CARMA2_HW.EXE: FLEETRES.EXE -reg HKCU "Software\Zeus Software\nGlide" Resolution sz <idx>, and the same for Aspect with sz 1. Prefer an explicit per-box index over '1 By desktop'. 'By desktop' is the LIVE desktop: GetSystemMetrics is read when glide2x.dll loads, so a desktop another game stranded at 640x480 yields 640x480. That is exactly the failure FLEETRES avoids by reading the persisted mode. Map %FR_W%x%FR_H% in cmd: 1920x1080 -> 21, 1280x960 -> 10, 1152x864 -> 6, 1024x768 -> 5, 800x600 -> 3, anything else -> 1. The values must be REG_SZ: a REG_DWORD reads as raw bytes, sscanf fails, and the default 'By app' silently remains. install.reg alone is weaker, because it is only merged at GAMESYNC.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: nGlide 1.02 in Carmageddon2\, and FLEETRES.EXE -reg ... sz (fleetres.c writes REG_SZ for any type other than dword). The change goes into the Carmageddon2 entry in scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (a post/marker block like glide_swap). No download.
titles.fix_risk: Low for display and aspect, now measured. Not observed: in-race 3D. The front end ignores synthetic clicks and Enter: a click on START at the 640x480 baseline did nothing (123_carma2_baseline_click2.png). ESC does skip the intro FMVs, which refutes 'ignores keys' for the FMV stage only. The HKCU key is global per user. Only UnrealGold also ships nGlide, and UE1 reaches it only through GlideDrv on GlideRender opt-in boxes, where the launcher moves the wrapper aside. Write the values at every launch: during this test another concurrent session REGDELETEd HKCU\Software\Zeus Software on .123 (agent log [00:43:50] box time) and also taskkilled my CARMA2_HW.EXE ([00:43:03]), so state set once can vanish. Pre-existing and unrelated to 1080p: glide_swap keys off FR_GLIDE (silicon present), not the GlideRender opt-in that FR_UE1DEV uses. On a box like .143, whose Voodoo is a secondary adapter behind the card driving the monitor, the launcher removes nGlide and the game would render to the Voodoo.
titles.hw_check: On .123 (done) or .145: write the two REG_SZ values with EXEC cmd /c reg add "HKCU\Software\Zeus Software\nGlide" /v Resolution /t REG_SZ /d 21 /f, and the same for Aspect with /d 1. Then EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Carmageddon2" "Play Carmageddon 2.bat". After 8-15 s DISPLAYCFG must read 1920x1080, not 640x480, and SCREENSHOT 0 should have its bbox at x=240..1680. Send UIKEY ESCAPE twice to reach the front end and SCREENSHOT it. In-race needs a human, because clicks on START are ignored. Then taskkill /f /im "CARMA2_HW.EXE", confirm DISPLAYCFG 1920x1080, and delete the test key with reg delete "HKCU\Software\Zeus Software" /f if the fix is not yet staged.
titles.verifier_notes: Survey fix CONFIRMED on hardware, with refinements: use an explicit index rather than By desktop, REG_SZ is mandatory, and write at every launch. Correction: add -D3D (and -NOCUTSCENE) to the switch list. Correction: 'front end ignores click and key' is partly wrong, because ESC skips the FMVs. My .123 test was interrupted by other sessions: a GLQuake launch, a taskkill of my game, and a REGDELETE of my test key. The interference is visible in hw/logs/123-agent.log.1. Final state on .123 was verified: no Carmageddon process, desktop 1920x1080, HKCU\Software\Zeus Software absent.

titles.title: RedneckRampage
titles.engine: Build engine (Xatrix/Interplay), DOS/4GW RR.EXE, ROUTE66M.EXE and AGAIN\RA.EXE (GOG Collection), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74 (md5 33294e0a...) with machine=vesa_nolfb; the tree also ships NOLFB.COM
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed statically. All seven .bat files contain the FLEETRES -ini dosboxRR.conf sdl fullresolution %FR_DOSFULLRES% line (grep: one each). The per-game confs are [IPX]/[autoexec] only. GAMERES rule: gameres.h:794. REDNECK.CFG and AGAIN\REDNECK.CFG set ScreenMode=1 (VESA 2.0), 800x600. Deployed dosboxRR.conf on the four LCD boxes: desktop/overlay/aspect=true. The 08-31 .123 capture has content at x=240..1680. Not re-run tonight.
titles.menu_source: The in-game menus have no video-mode item (RR.EXE strings: SCREEN SIZE, brightness and so on). The game's own SETUP (SETMAIN.EXE) has a HARDCODED 'Choose a VESA 1.0/2.0 Mode' list: 320x200, 640x480, 800x600, 1024x768, 1280x1024, 1600x1200. It has no %d x %d formatter, so it cannot enumerate. At start RR.EXE checks the choice against the VBE ('VESA driver for ( %ld * %ld ) not found/supported!'). DOSBox 0.74's S3 VBE tops out at 1280x1024 and has no 1920x1080. Redneck Rampage Setup.bat opens a choice /c123 prompt first.
titles.evidence: Static checks: grep of all seven launchers; strings of SETMAIN.EXE (lines 6146-6164) and RR.EXE/AGAIN\RA.EXE; REDNECK.CFG lines 24-26; dosboxRR_settings.conf (choice /c123); DOSBox 0.74 mode table in survey-dosbox-descent-carma/static/dosbox074-vesa-mode-table.txt; prior capture survey-dosbox-descent-carma/prior-0831/123_RedneckRampage_Play_Redneck_Rampage_-_Game.png (bbox 240..1680).
titles.fix: None possible for 1080p inside the DOS game: SETUP's list, DOSBox 0.74's VBE and the DOS Build framebuffer (MAXXDIM 1600, background knowledge) all stop short of it. The desktop+aspect=true pillarbox is already correct. Optional, not a 1080p fix: 1024x768 is on SETUP's list and in DOSBox's VBE table (0x105), so ScreenWidth/Height 1024/768 in both staged REDNECK.CFG copies would give a sharper 4:3 picture. The frame rate under DOSBox is untested. No source port (Raze, NBlood, Rednukem, EDuke32, Erampage) is on the share (re-searched case-insensitively tonight).
titles.fix_source: The current answer is already in the tree (stage-fleetres.py 'RedneckRampage', gameres.h:794). The optional 1024x768 is a two-line edit to staged REDNECK.CFG and AGAIN\REDNECK.CFG. A source port would need downloading.
titles.fix_risk: None for the no-change answer. Optional 1024x768: higher DOSBox CPU load (cycles=auto) and an unmeasured frame rate. It is a staged constant that is valid on every box, since DOSBox scales it. REDNECK.CFG also carries network settings, so any edit must keep them byte-identical apart from the two keys.
titles.hw_check: On .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\RedneckRampage" "Play Redneck Rampage - Game.bat". DISPLAYCFG stays 1920x1080 and SCREENSHOT content is at x=240..1680. For the list: run 'Redneck Rampage Setup.bat', send UIKEY 1 at the choice prompt, go to Screen Setup > VESA modes, SCREENSHOT the six fixed entries, then Esc out WITHOUT saving (saving rewrites REDNECK.CFG). Kill DOSBox with PROCKILL <pid> if EXEC is sluggish. Whether synthetic keys reach DOSBox is unverified. On .195 (Win7) UIKEY RETURN did not reach Shadow Warrior's menu tonight.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed; no refutation found. Added the optional 1024x768 note and the source-port re-search. The .240 EDID caveat from Daggerfall applies here too.

titles.title: ShadowWarrior
titles.engine: Build engine (3D Realms), original DOS Shadow Warrior 1.2 (SW.EXE = SW.DAT, md5 0c76df2d; Wanton.dat for Wanton Destruction; each launch runs @COPY SW.DAT/WANTON.DAT sw.exe), GOG's DOSBox 0.74. Not a source port.
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed, and the aspect defect is now reproduced on hardware. All five launchers write fullresolution into dosbox_swarrior.conf, which is passed first. The dosboxSW_sw/_td/_wd/_lan and _swipxhost confs are [ipx]/[autoexec] only. GAMERES rule: gameres.h:798. The staged and deployed dosbox_swarrior.conf both have aspect=false at line 52. MEASURED on .195 (Win7, HD 5450, 00:56): main menu content 1728x1080 at x=96..1824, i.e. 320x200 shown as square pixels at 16:10, about 20% too wide. The 08-31 .123 and .246 captures show the same.
titles.menu_source: The Options menu has no resolution item. SW.DAT contains '%d x %d mode selected.', the 'swres' cheat, 'VESA mode %ld x %ld not found' and the getvalidvesamodes code, so F5/swres cycle VBE-reported modes: the original 3DR ResChange keeps 320x200, 640x400, 640x480 and 800x600. That comes from the jfsw commented-out source; it was not observed in game. SETUP (Setmain.exe) has a HARDCODED 'Choose a VESA 1.0/2.0 Mode' list of 320x200, 320x400, 640x480, 800x600, confirmed in strings (no formatter). DOSBox 0.74's S3 VBE maximum is 1280x1024, with no 1920x1080.
titles.evidence: Staged tree /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library/ShadowWarrior: five launchers, dosbox_swarrior.conf (fullresolution=desktop, output=overlay, machine=svga_s3, aspect=false, scaler=normal2x), SW.CFG ScreenMode=2 320x200 (dragon\SW.CFG identical, md5 ec62e1b5), Setmain.exe strings. Hardware, under .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/hw/: 195_sw_baseline_25s.png (bbox 96..1824, the defect) and 195_sw_aspecttrue_25s.png (bbox 240..1679 with the fix).
titles.fix: VERIFIED on .195. Passing a conf that contains only '[render]' / 'aspect=true' AFTER the others changed the main menu to 1440x1080 at x=240..1679. That confirms DOSBox 0.74 lets a later -conf override the key. The simplest staged fix is to change aspect=false to aspect=true in dosbox_swarrior.conf, which is right on both LCDs and CRTs (on a CRT with 'original', DOSBox then asks for 640x480 instead of 640x400). Alternatively, append [render] aspect=true to the four dosboxSW_*.conf files. Optional sharper picture, still 4:3 and untested: SW.CFG ScreenMode=1 (VESA 2.0) with 640x480 or 800x600, both on SETUP's list and in DOSBox's VBE table.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: one key in Games-Library/ShadowWarrior/dosbox_swarrior.conf (or the four dosboxSW_*.conf). No download. It reaches boxes only through GAMESYNC (GAMESYNC RESET+START on provisioned boxes, because the boot-time sync idles once gamesync.done exists).
titles.fix_risk: Very low. The key is overlay-scaled, so there is no CPU cost, and it is right on every panel type, so it can be a staged constant. No LAN impact. The fix must reach all five launchers; either location covers them.
titles.hw_check: Done on .195. To repeat on XP (.145): EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\ShadowWarrior" "Play Shadow Warrior.bat" and wait about 25 s for the main menu without sending keys. SCREENSHOT should show bbox x=240..1680 after the fix (x=96..1824 today). Kill with taskkill /f /im "DOSBox.exe" or PROCKILL. For the F5 list a human is safer: on .195, UIKEY RETURN x3 did not reach the SW menu (195_sw_ingame_start.png unchanged), and on .123 two UIKEY ESCAPE during the intro ended the DOSBox session. Agent-driven F5/swres testing is unverified.
titles.verifier_notes: Defect and fix both CONFIRMED on hardware (A/B on .195 using a temporary _review_aspect.conf plus _review_sw_aspect.bat, both deleted afterwards and verified absent; the deployed conf is untouched, aspect=false). The in-game F5 list is still source-derived and was not observed. My .123 baseline attempt was disrupted by another session launching GLQuake on the same box (agent log [00:48:50]).

titles.title: Descent1 - Play Descent.bat (default DOSBox shortcut)
titles.engine: Descent DOS registered v1.4a (DESCENTR.EXE, 'Registered v1.4a May 2, 1995'), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74 with output=ddraw
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed. Play, Host LAN, Join LAN and Sound Setup each contain the FLEETRES -ini dosboxD1.conf sdl fullresolution line; dosboxD1.conf is passed first. GAMERES rule: gameres.h:795. dosboxD1_single.conf runs a plain DESCENTR.EXE, which renders 320x200. Deployed conf on the four LCD boxes: desktop/ddraw/aspect=true. The 08-31 capture on .123 shows content at x=240..1679.
titles.menu_source: No resolution option in the game's menus. I re-decoded DESCENT.TXB from DESCENT.HOG: Options..., Detail levels..., Brightness, sound and controls, and no 'Screen resolution' string (Descent II's TXB has one; Descent 1 v1.4a does not). The mode comes only from command-line switches in DESCENTR.EXE (-320x240, -320x400, -640x400, -640x480, -320x100); the maximum is 640x480 VESA.
titles.evidence: Staged launchers (printed), dosboxD1.conf lines 25/27/46/47, dosboxD1_single.conf, the TXB decode of DESCENT.HOG (done tonight; 159 HOG entries, 622 TXB lines), and survey-dosbox-descent-carma/prior-0831/123_Descent1_Play_Descent.png (bbox 240..1679).
titles.fix: None possible in this engine (640x480 ceiling). The 1080p path in this tree is the Rebirth shortcut. Optional and untested: add -640x480 to DESCENTR.EXE in dosboxD1_single.conf for a sharper 4:3 picture.
titles.fix_risk: None (no change). A pre-existing hazard for THIS shortcut comes from the Rebirth shortcut; see the next entry. D1X rewrites the shared DESCENT.CFG with its own keys only, which drops DigiDeviceID=0xe016 and the other DOS sound keys. Since GAMESYNC does not re-run on a provisioned box, the DOS build then stays without its sound config until someone runs GAMESYNC RESET+START.
titles.hw_check: Already measured on .123, .240 and .246 (08-31). For .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent1" "Play Descent.bat". DISPLAYCFG stays 1920x1080 and SCREENSHOT content is about 1440x1080 at x=240. There is no resolution menu.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed; the TXB was re-decoded independently. Added the cross-shortcut DESCENT.CFG hazard, which was measured on D2X tonight.

titles.title: Descent1 - Play Descent - Rebirth.bat (D1X-Rebirth)
titles.engine: D1X-Rebirth v0.58.1 (32-bit, OpenGL, SDL 1.2 windib). Same 0.58.1 code base as the D2X build verified tonight. The share's dxx-rebirth_20220622-win.zip is x86-64 (libgcc_s_seh-1.dll) and unusable on the 32-bit XP boxes, as the launcher itself says.
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed. The launcher writes ResolutionX/Y with FLEETRES -kv, and GAMERES gameres.h:782-783 mirrors it. The deployed DESCENT.CFG on all four LCD boxes has ResolutionX=1920, ResolutionY=1080 and no AspectX/Y, so the defaults 3/4 apply. The 4:3 projection is stretched 1.33x across the 16:9 panel; this was MEASURED on the identical D2X engine (see Descent2). 2D art and the cockpit are stretched to 16:9 by design. New: '-pilot fleet' does NOT skip pilot selection when fleet.plr is absent. On .240 D2X showed the SELECT PILOT dialog despite -pilot fleet (240_d2x_after_esc.png), so the launcher's 'skips the pilot modal' comment is false on such boxes.
titles.menu_source: Options... > 'Screen resolution...' is built from gr_list_modes() = SDL_ListModes(NULL, SDL_OPENGL|SDL_FULLSCREEN), largest first, at most 50 entries, plus 'use custom values' (resolution and aspect fields). Verified on hardware with D2X 0.58.1 on .240: the list shows 1920x1080 at the top, then 1776x1000, 1440x900, 1360x1024, 1360x768, 1280x1024, 1280x960 and down (240_d2x_screenres.png). D1X uses the same code and the same strings ('Screen resolution...', 'use custom values') but was not launched tonight. Choosing a preset sets AspectY=W/gcd and AspectX=H/gcd.
titles.evidence: Strings in d1x-rebirth.exe (AspectX, AspectY, 'Screen resolution...'). Source excerpts: survey-dosbox-descent-carma/static/dxx-rebirth-0.58.1-aspect-excerpts.txt. Deployed DESCENT.CFG copies: survey-dosbox-descent-carma/boxes/*_Descent1__DESCENT.CFG. Hardware (D2X, same code) under .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/hw/: 240_d2x_screenres.png, 240_d2x_level_a.png (3/4), 240_d2x_b_level.png (9/16), 240_d2x_door_A_default_vs_B_aspect916.png.
titles.fix: Write the aspect with the resolution in the engine's swapped convention: AspectX=9, AspectY=16 on a 16:9 panel, and 3/4 elsewhere. Drive it from FR_ASPECT, which is the panel's physical aspect and the quantity the engine wants; it equals W:H only at an LCD's native mode. Use FLEETRES.EXE -kv "%~dp0DESCENT.CFG" AspectX 9 (and AspectY 16) in the same if-exist block. VERIFIED on D2X on .240. -kv replaced the existing AspectX=3/AspectY=4 lines D2X had written. In flight the far door went from about 1.43:1 to roughly square, and the corridor side walls moved outward. The result is Hor+, vertical view unchanged; the 2D cockpit stays stretched. GAMERES rows are optional, because every Rebirth shortcut runs FLEETRES before the engine. If they are added, gameres.h must compute exactly the launcher's value, or the two writers fight and '0 value(s) changed' is lost. Also consider fixing -pilot: stage a fleet.plr, or point -pilot at the staged PLAYER pilot.
titles.fix_source: The engine already reads AspectX/AspectY. Change the Descent1 kv_cfg pairs in scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py; gameres.h and test_gameres_mirror.py only if GAMERES rows are wanted. FR_ASPECT is already emitted by FLEETRES -cmd (README-FLEETRES), but FLEETRES.BAT has no fallback line for it, so add 'if not defined FR_ASPECT set FR_ASPECT=4:3'. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Low for the projection, which is now measured. Pre-existing hazard, sharpened: DXX rewrites the SHARED DESCENT.CFG as soon as a pilot is selected, not only on exit. Measured on D2X at .240: a force-killed session still left a rewritten file containing only DXX keys. For Descent1 that drops the DOS build's DigiDeviceID=0xe016 and related keys, and the DOS shortcut is the title's DEFAULT. The keys stay gone until GAMESYNC re-copies the staged file, which does not happen automatically on provisioned boxes. Consider re-applying the DOS sound keys from the DOS launchers with -kv.
titles.hw_check: On .145 or .240: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent1" "Play Descent - Rebirth.bat". Send UIKEY ESCAPE x3 past the intro; keyboard input works. If SELECT PILOT appears (no fleet.plr), choose PLAYER with the arrows and Enter. OPTIONS is the 4th main-menu item > SCREEN RESOLUTION...: SCREENSHOT the list, then Esc. NEW GAME > Enter > Enter > Esc x2 past the briefing, then SCREENSHOT in flight and compare a square door or texture before and after the Aspect keys. Finish with taskkill /f /im "d1x-rebirth.exe", then restore DESCENT.CFG and any .plr/.plx files the game touched (back them up first).
titles.verifier_notes: 'yes' is kept and now hardware-backed through the identical D2X build, not observed on D1X itself. The aspect fix is confirmed on hardware (D2X). Corrections: the config is rewritten on pilot selection, not only on exit; and -pilot fleet does not suppress the pilot dialog when fleet.plr is missing.

titles.title: Descent2 - Play Descent 2.bat and the Host/Join LAN launchers (D2X-Rebirth, default)
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed and MEASURED on .240 (XP, X800, 01:16-01:21). Play, Host LAN and Join LAN all write ResolutionX/Y with FLEETRES -kv, and GAMERES gameres.h:784-785 mirrors it. D2X opened an SDL_app window at 0,0-1920x1080 with DISPLAYCFG at 1920x1080x32. In flight the 3D fills the screen. With the default AspectX=3/AspectY=4 the projection is stretched about 1.33x horizontally: the square door at the corridor end measured about 80x56 px (1.43:1). The 2D title, menus and cockpit art are stretched to 16:9 by design.
titles.menu_source: VERIFIED on .240. Main menu: NEW GAME, LOAD GAME..., MULTIPLAYER..., OPTIONS... (the 4th item, not the 5th as the survey said), CHANGE PILOTS... Under Options, SCREEN RESOLUTION... shows the driver-enumerated list with 1920x1080 first, then 1776x1000, 1440x900, 1360x1024, 1360x768, 1280x1024, 1280x960, 1280x800, 1280x768, 1280x720, 1152x864, 1024x768, 848x480, 800x600 and more. 'use custom values' is also available.
titles.evidence: Under .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/hw/: 240_d2x_mainmenu.png, 240_d2x_options.png, 240_d2x_screenres.png, 240_d2x_level_a.png (3/4), 240_d2x_b_level.png (9/16), 240_d2x_door_A_default_vs_B_aspect916.png, 240_Descent2_DESCENT.CFG.before-test, and 240_Descent2_DESCENT.CFG.after-test-rewritten-by-d2x (D2X wrote AspectX=3/AspectY=4 and dropped DESCENTW's Digi*/Midi*/Redbook*/VR_* keys). Also the staged Host/Join launchers (printed; each has the -kv lines).
titles.fix: Same as Descent1 Rebirth, VERIFIED here. FLEETRES -kv DESCENT.CFG AspectX 9 and AspectY 16 on 16:9 (3/4 on 4:3, chosen from FR_ASPECT) made the door roughly square and widened the horizontal view (Hor+). The cockpit bitmap stays stretched. The lines go into all three launchers.
titles.fix_source: The engine side is in the tree. Correction to the survey: only 'Play Descent 2.bat' is generated by scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (the Descent2 entry). 'Host Descent 2 - LAN.bat' and 'Join Descent 2 - LAN.bat' are hand-written staged files; there is no generator in the repo, and only tests/python/test_lan_dosipx_library.py references them. They must be edited in the library directly, following the staged-game loop. GAMERES rows and test_gameres_mirror.py only if wanted. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Low for the projection. Client-side only, so UDP 42424 LAN is unaffected. Pre-existing and measured: D2X rewrites DESCENT.CFG at pilot selection, which strips the Win95 DESCENTW.EXE keys (DigiDeviceID8/16, Digi*, MidiDeviceID, Redbook*, VR_*) that the 'original Win95' fallback shortcut relies on. A rewrite-on-select also means GAMESYNC sees the file as changed after every play session. The launchers' '-pilot fleet' shows the SELECT PILOT dialog on a box without fleet.plr (.240 has only PLAYER.PLR and a d2host LAN pilot), so an unattended start stalls there.
titles.hw_check: Done on .240. Procedure: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent2" "Play Descent 2.bat", UIKEY ESCAPE x3, choose a pilot with arrows and Enter, OPTIONS (4th) > SCREEN RESOLUTION (screenshot), Esc x2, NEW GAME > Enter > Enter > Esc x2, SCREENSHOT in flight. Back up DESCENT.CFG first and restore it after taskkill /f /im "d2x-rebirth.exe". On Win7 .195 GDI capture may be black; use DISPLAYCFG and WINLIST there.
titles.verifier_notes: Menu 'yes', stretch and fix all CONFIRMED on hardware. Corrections: Options is the 4th item; the Host/Join launchers are hand-written, not generated; the DESCENT.CFG rewrite happens at pilot selection and removes DESCENTW's keys; -pilot fleet does not skip pilot selection without fleet.plr. My test's side effects on .240: DESCENT.CFG was restored byte-identical from my backup (only the mtime changed). D2X also rewrote C:\Games\Descent2\d2host.plr and d2host.plx, a pilot left by the 08-30 LAN test and not a library file. Sizes are unchanged at 729/924 B, but the originals could not be restored. PLAYER.PLR was untouched.

titles.title: Descent2 - Play Descent 2 - original Win95.bat (DESCENTW.EXE)
titles.engine: Descent II Win95 DirectDraw build (DESCENTW.EXE md5 93735643), behind the generated disc-mount launcher (d2disc.iso)
titles.launch_sets: Confirmed. The launcher (24,545 B) has no FLEETRES block; its one 'FLEETRES' match is a comment, and it runs start "" /D "%~dp0" "%GAME%" with GAME=DESCENTW.EXE. DESCENTW sets its own DirectDraw mode, 800x600 at most. requires.json scopes disc_mount to this shortcut only.
titles.menu_source: Options > 'Screen resolution...' opens 'Select screen mode', a hardcoded list in DESCENTW.EXE: 320x200, 640x480, then 'Modes w/o Cockpit:' 640x400 and 800x600. It can also report 'Mode not supported by your DirectDraw driver'.
titles.evidence: DESCENTW.EXE strings (survey-dosbox-descent-carma/static/binary-strings.txt); 'Play Descent 2 - original Win95.bat' lines 60 and 249 (grep); Descent2/requires.json per-shortcut rules.
titles.fix: None possible for this binary; the list is hardcoded and tops out at 800x600. The 1080p path is the default Rebirth shortcut. Note that running Rebirth removes this build's sound keys from the shared DESCENT.CFG; see the Rebirth entry.
titles.hw_check: Optional, on a box with a disc mounter: start the shortcut, use the keyboard (Descent's menus are keyboard-navigable) to reach Options > Screen resolution..., and screenshot the four entries. DirectDraw exclusive mode may capture as black or with an 8-bpp palette.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed; no refutation. The staged DESCENT.CFG keys this build needs are wiped whenever D2X runs (measured on .240).

titles.title: Descent3
titles.engine: Descent 3 1.4.0 (official 1.4 no-CD file set; main.exe md5 61db25d7, 1,789,952 B), Direct3D renderer (install.reg PreferredRenderer=3; RS_bitdepth defaults to 16)
titles.launch_sets: REFUTED in effect. The survey and PER-TITLE-STATUS ('Descent3 1080p') assume -Width/-Height gives a 1920x1080 game. MEASURED: -Width 1920 -Height 1080 does switch the display to 1920x1080 (DISPLAYCFG 1920x1080x16, 'Descent 3' window 0,0-1920x1080), but the in-flight view is a 640x480 box centred on a black screen. This was seen at x=640..1280, y=300..780 on .195 (Win7, HD 5450) and on .240 (XP, X800); the HUD message line at the top is still laid out on the full 1920 width. The same happened with -Width 1280 -Height 960 (a 640x480 box in a 1280x960 mode) and with RS_resolution=5 (list 1280x960) and no switches. Cause, from the source release and confirmed on hardware: at SM_GAME the 3D window is sized from the PILOT file's saved game_window_w/h (InitGameScreen(gw,gh), clamped to the display), unless the resolution was just changed in the Video menu. The staged Descent3\sdf.plt stores 640x480 at file offsets 0x1F/0x23. Pressing '=' about 12 times grows the window to full screen; after that the 4:3 projection is visibly stretched 1.33x on 16:9, because rend_GetAspectRatio assumes a 4:3 monitor. The menus themselves always run at 640x480x16.
titles.menu_source: VERIFIED on .195. Options > VIDEO > RESOLUTION shows exactly seven hardcoded 4:3 buttons: 512x384, 640x480, 800x600, 960x720, 1024x768, 1280x960, 1600x1200. None is checked when the game is started with -Width/-Height, because the custom slot has no button (195_d3_options.png). The survey's claim that these menus 'CANNOT be driven by the agent' is REFUTED. On .195 and .240 UIKEY ESCAPE skipped the intro movie, Enter chose the pilot, arrows and Enter walked the main menu into Options and New Game > Pilot Training, and '=' resized the in-game view. README-FLEET.txt and requires.json say otherwise and are out of date.
titles.evidence: Under .claude/evidence-1080p/review-dosbox-descent-carma/hw/: 195_d3_options.png (the list); 195_d3_after_training_21s.png and 195_d3_ingame_46s.png (640x480 box inside 1920x1080); 195_d3_1280_ingame.png (box inside 1280x960); 195_d3_rsres5_ingame.png; 240_d3_1080_ingame.png (XP, same box); 240_d3_after_eq12.png ('=' x12: full screen, stretched); 240_d3_rvw_ingame_noaspect.png (patched pilot: full 1920x1080 from level start); 240_d3_rvw_ingame_aspect178.png (patched pilot plus -aspect 1.78); rvw.plt.test-pilot; 240_sdf.plt.after-test and 195_sdf.plt.after-test (the game upgrades the pilot 0x2A->0x2B, 1770->1772 B, at mission start). Source: DescentDevelopers/Descent3 pilot_class.cpp read_hud_data (uint8 hud_mode, uint16 hud_stat, uint16 hud_graphical_stat, int game_window_w, int game_window_h) and game.cpp SetScreenMode(SM_GAME) -> InitGameScreen, which clamps to Max_window_w/h.
titles.fix: (1) The real fix: stage Descent3\sdf.plt with its saved game window raised. Assert the old dwords 640/480 at offsets 0x1F/0x23 of the version-0x2A file, then write 4096/4096. InitGameScreen clamps to the display, so this one staged constant is right on every box (1920x1080 on the LCDs, the tube's own mode on CRTs). VERIFIED on .240 with a temporary copy (rvw.plt, -pilot RVW): the level opened full-screen at 1920x1080. Keep -Width %FR_W% -Height %FR_H% in both client launchers. (2) Add -pilot SDF to 'Play Descent 3.bat' (the Join launcher already has it); otherwise every start stops at the PILOTS dialog. (3) Optional: -aspect 1.78 on 16:9 panels (set D3ASP from FR_ASPECT; 1.6 for 16:10). It fixes proportions (the doorframe became about 390x390 from 390x290), with the trade-off in fix_risk. (4) Update PER-TITLE-STATUS, README-FLEET and requires.json: drop the stale disc_mount and the 'not automatable' note. Optionally stage RS_bitdepth=32 in install.reg, since the game runs 16-bit by default. That is cosmetic.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: a small byte edit to the staged sdf.plt (no generator exists for it; stage-fleetres.py has no binary writer), plus 'Play Descent 3.bat' generated from the stage-fleetres.py 'Descent3' entry. 'Join Descent 3 - LAN.bat' is hand-written (no generator in the repo). -aspect is in main.exe 1.4 and in README.TXT. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Pilot patch: low. The offsets are specific to pilot version 0x2A, so the patch must assert 640/480 first. The game rewrites sdf.plt at the first mission start on each box (upgrading it to 0x2B and saving the clamped size), so after play the box's copy differs from the library and GAMESYNC will re-copy it; that is benign. Multiplayer and the dedicated server are unaffected. -aspect 1.78, measured: 1.4 applies it by zooming the vertical axis (the source's 'if (s <= 0.0f)' branch never scales x). The vertical field of view shrinks, the 3D cockpit's radar and weapon monitors are pushed partly off the bottom of the screen, and the 2D shield/energy readouts no longer sit on the cockpit. Without it, the full-screen view is the 4:3 projection stretched 1.33x. That is a taste call; the pilot fix is not.
titles.hw_check: On .240 or .195 (no human needed): EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent3" "Play Descent 3.bat". Press UIKEY ESCAPE to skip the long intro and UIKEY RETURN at PILOTS (SDF). For the menu check: DOWN x3, RETURN, SCREENSHOT the VIDEO page, then ESC. For the in-game check: UP x3, RETURN (New Game), DOWN, RETURN (Pilot Training), wait about 25 s, then DISPLAYCFG (1920x1080x16) and SCREENSHOT 0. It works on XP and was also captured on Win7 .195. Expect bbox 0..1920 after the fix (x=640..1280 today). Clean up afterwards: taskkill /f /im "main.exe"; delete C:\Games\Descent3\custom\cache\d3s*.tmp and .lock (a killed run leaves about 1.2 MB there); restore sdf.plt from the library with copy /y from \\192.168.1.122\files\Files\Games-Library\Descent3\sdf.plt, which keeps its mtime.
titles.verifier_notes: MAJOR correction. The staged launcher has never produced a 1080p game: 1920x1080 display, 640x480 view. The survey's -aspect fix is valid for proportions but secondary and has side effects; the pilot file is the primary fix. menu 'no' is CONFIRMED on hardware, and 'menus not agent-drivable' is REFUTED. The earlier '.240 1920x1080 verified' compat row is a desktop screenshot, as the survey said. Cleanup verified: sdf.plt matches the library on .123, .195 and .240 (restored on .195 and .240 by copy from the share, original mtime); .195's RS_resolution was put back to 7 (the only registry value I changed); the cache temp files were deleted on all three boxes; rvw.plt and _review_d3.bat were deleted. My first .123 run was disrupted by another session's windowed GLQuake, so the results come from .195 and .240. These findings (pilot-window cause, keyboard-drivable menus, Win7 capture works for this DX6-era title) belong in FINDINGS.md and PER-TITLE-STATUS.md in the fix phase.
